newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian firm plans cement plant in Sulawesi.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian firm plans cement plant in Sulawesi.

text.p: Indonesia's private PT Cipta Cakra Murdaya plans to build a cement plant in central Sulawesi to start production by 2000 with annual output of three million tonnes, the official Antara news agency reported on Saturday.
It quoted the company's president-director Hartati Cakra Murdaya as saying the estimated cost of the plant was 1.5 trillion rupiah.
She said 70 percent of output would be sold domestically with the balance exported.
